review.mathematicalCheck: An event containing five of the five sample points equals the entire sample space, so it is certain and has probability 1. Under classical counting this also gives 5/5 = 1; equal likelihood is unnecessary for the written certainty argument.
review.levelCheck: Recognizing the whole sample space is a complete elementary approach within scope.
review.methodDistinctness: The certainty argument is sufficient. A second ratio calculation would add little useful insight.
review.annotationCheck: cnm_308 is a defensible route-neutral target because the event is necessarily certain. cnm_h135 and prerequisite cnm_h134 match the written recognition. Replacing cnm_285 is justified by this target, without claiming classical counting was performed. Empty shared supports are appropriate.
